## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, kubeconfigs, Terraform state or `.tfvars` committed
- [ ] Terraform changes: `terraform fmt` applied and `terraform plan` reviewed
- [ ] Any step that creates cloud resources states its estimated cost
- [ ] README capabilities and ROADMAP updated only for what is built and demonstrated
